notes.title: Thank You & First Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33704699/8202f2f945add49c7bbd7bc865e5bd05b75ac331.png[/img]
Above are some reactions from playthroughs by:
JackSepticEye, GG Gab, Neurobew, RiskRim, LP, Dom Plays, DX Army, Explosion Network

Thank you to everyone for playing and for your helpful feedback!

We have really enjoyed watching everyone's reactions to playing the game so far.

We've also released an update with some minor fixes.

Changes in this update (1.01):
- Fixed an issue where some played couldn't get the "Returned" achievement.
- Added some polish & tweaks to the second test

Please give us your feedback on the discussion forums and let us know what you think! We'll do our best to support this game as much as we can.

- Andy
